name: Adcaver Ad Helper
author: adcaver

sections.description:
The Adcaver Ad Helper plugin makes it simple for publishers to connect their WordPress site to the Adcaver ad network.

Features:

  • Easy Setup: Add your Adcaver Site ID and Verification Code directly within your WordPress admin.
  • Automatic Verification: Automatically inserts the necessary meta tag for Adcaver site ownership verification.
  • Automatic Ad Placement: Configure ads to display automatically before/after content, between paragraphs on posts, pages, and homepage.
  • Overlay Ad Management: Easily enable or disable high-impact ad formats (Vignette, Anchor, Sticky Bar) with simple toggles. Scripts are loaded directly from the Adcaver network.
  • Lightweight: Designed to be minimal and focused, ensuring minimal impact on your site’s performance.

This plugin is intended for publishers using the Adcaver ad network. You need an active publisher account on adcaver.com to use this plugin.

Support

For support, please visit the Adcaver support section or contact our support team directly through the Adcaver website.

Additional Resources

  • Adcaver Website
  • Publisher Dashboard
  • Advertiser Dashboard
  • Ad Placements Guide
sections.installation:
1. Upload the adcaver-ad-helper folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, OR install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Adcaver Ads.
  4. Follow the instructions on the settings page:
    • Sign up/log in at adcaver.com and submit your site to get your Site ID and (if needed) Verification Code.
    • Enter your Adcaver Site ID in the settings field.
    • If provided by Adcaver, paste your Verification Code into the settings field.
    • Configure automatic ad placements for posts, pages, or homepage.
    • Enable the desired overlay ad formats (Vignette, Anchor, Sticky Bar).
    • Save changes.
  5. If you entered a verification code, go back to your Adcaver dashboard and click the button to verify your site.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Site ID and Verification Code?

You get these from your publisher dashboard on adcaver.com after you sign up and submit your website for approval.

Do the overlay ads (Vignette, Anchor, Sticky Bar) require shortcodes?

No. If you enable them in the plugin settings and have entered your Site ID, the necessary scripts will be loaded automatically on your site’s frontend.

Does this plugin display the ads itself?

No. This plugin manages the settings and loads the ads from adcaver.com. The actual ad fetching and display logic is handled by adcaver, connecting back to the main Adcaver ad server.

How do I get started with Adcaver?

Visit adcaver.com to create a publisher account and submit your site for approval. Once approved, you’ll receive your Site ID and can start monetizing your content.

  • Code Standards: Fixed function naming to comply with WordPress.org prefix requirements.
  • Removed: Shortcode functionality (automatic ad placements still fully functional).

1.0.1

  • Security: Added ABSPATH checks to all PHP files to prevent direct file access.
  • Security: Enhanced protection against unauthorized direct execution of plugin files.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Features: Settings page, Verification Code insertion, Site ID storage, Overlay Ad toggles, Shortcode display.
